why: The project formalizes only the d_X = 0 half of the remark: A = two chart-level facts (every N is in good position to E; C_e = E when d_C(e) = 0), Definition 4.16 good position at points with d_X(a) = 0, and a GLOBAL corner structure on A when d_X ≡ 0 on A. B is local and has two claims. Its first (near a with d_X(a) = 0, A ∩ W is a classical manifold without boundary) IS proved from A (A_to_B1, rt_check OK): restrict A to the open W = {d_X < 1} (Lemma 2.23), apply A's hasCornerStructure_of_degIndex_eq_zero to the smooth submanifold A ∩ W, and d_{A∩W} ≡ 0 by Lemma 2.26 (d_A ≤ d_X). Its second (near a point where T_aA is in good position — read by B chart-wise, Definition 3.21 to C_z in E — A ∩ W has a corner structure, no tameness) is absent from A: it is a local Theorem 4.18 (Proposition 4.9 in a chart re-centred at a), believed true but genuinely not in A (the project only has it as Theorem 4.18 for tame X, item V4_41). (B's reading of 'good position' as Definition 3.21 to C_z in E, rather than Definition 4.16 inside T_aX, and its added 'without boundary' are flagged choices of the blind file, not bugs.) B ⇒ A fails: A's first three conjuncts are statements B does not make (general chart facts; Definition 4.16 good position at d_X = 0), and the global corner structure would need gluing B's local corner structures on the subtypes A ∩ W_a into an atlas on A.
overlap: n/a (neither full direction proved); A_to_B1 uses A's hasCornerStructure_of_degIndex_eq_zero plus isOpen_setOf_degIndex_lt, lemma_2_26, paracompactSpace_subtype, IsScSmoothOn.mono and the V4_9 glue.
